Package io.github._3xhaust.state

Class State<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.state.State<T>
public class State<T> extends Object
Observable container for a single value. Listeners are notified whenever the value is replaced via set(Object) (or transformed via update(Function)).

Multiple listeners are supported. Use subscribe(Consumer) to add a listener that you'll dispose later via the returned AutoCloseable.
